categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and touches src/net_processing.cpp and src/node/txrelay.h to manage transaction relay state.
categories.rationale: Encapsulates peer transaction relay state and replaces recursive mutexes with standard mutexes and thread-safety annotations. This resolves fragile lock ordering in net_processing, though it is primarily an internal refactoring.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Tests added (txrelay_tests.cpp and fuzz/txrelay.cpp) pin the behavior of the specific p2p relay component rather than modifying shared test infrastructure.
categories.rationale: The PR only adds tests specific to TxRelay; per the category definition, tests of a particular area belong to that area rather than test infrastructure.
